text: You see Dugan, craver of Nuka-Cola.

text: You see a very tall thin man with glasses. He has a bottle of Nuka-Cola clutched in his hand.
source_text:
You see a very tall thin man with glasses.
 He has a bottle of Nuka-Cola clutched in his hand.

text: Yes?
source_text: Yes?

text: I'm just looking around, thanks.
source_text: I'm just looking around, thanks.

text: What do you do around here?
source_text: What do you do around here?

text: What's with the Nuka-Cola?
source_text: What's with the Nuka-Cola?

text: Whose in charge around here?
source_text: Whose in charge around here?

text: Ah, never mind.
source_text: Ah, never mind.

text: Dah, Cola, good?
source_text: Dah, Cola, good?

text: Well, then stop wasting my time.
source_text: Well, then stop wasting my time.

text: I pontificate on life a lot, and help the Blades understand the true meaning of Nuka-Cola.
source_text:
I pontificate on life a lot, and help the Blades understand
 the true meaning of Nuka-Cola.

text: What's so good about Nuka-Cola?
source_text: What's so good about Nuka-Cola?

text: Is that all? That doesn't seem to help anyone that much.
source_text: Is that all? That doesn't seem to help anyone that much.

text: How much of that stuff do you drink?
source_text: How much of that stuff do you drink?

text: Can I ask you something else?
source_text: Can I ask you something else?

text: Ah, ok.  I'll be seeing you.
source_text: Ah, ok.  I'll be seeing you.

text: It is the stuff of life . . . Well actually, if I don't drink it on an hourly basis I get a splitting headache.
source_text:
It is the stuff of life . . . Well actually, if I don't drink it on
 an hourly basis I get a splitting headache.

text: So? [Dugan raises his eyebrows at you.]
source_text: So? [Dugan raises his eyebrows at you.]

text: About 5 litres a day.
source_text: About 5 litres a day.

text: Razor's the woman you'll want to talk to.
source_text: Razor's the woman you'll want to talk to.

text: I am the dumbest person I've ever met - well, besides you. Get out of here!
source_text: I am the dumbest person I've ever met - well, besides you. Get out of here!

text: I need another Nuka-Cola!
source_text: I need another Nuka-Cola!

text: Where'd my hair go!
source_text: Where'd my hair go!
